title: Grade 2 Science — Fri, Jun 05
description: Plants Around Us — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis — parts, types, uses and growth
subject: science

questions.question: Which part of the plant holds it in the soil?
questions.explanation: Roots hold the plant firmly in the soil and take in water.

questions.question: A small plant with a soft green stem is a:
questions.explanation: Herbs are small plants with soft, green stems.

questions.question: Which gas do plants give out that we need to breathe?
questions.explanation: Plants give out oxygen, which all living things need to breathe.

questions.question: A new plant grows from a:
questions.explanation: A seed grows into a new plant when it gets water, air and warmth.

questions.question: Which part of the plant makes food using sunlight?
questions.explanation: Green leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.

questions.question: A grapevine that climbs a wall with support is a:
questions.explanation: A grapevine is a climber, with a weak stem that needs support to climb.

questions.question: When we eat a carrot, which part of the plant are we eating?
questions.explanation: A carrot is the root of the plant.

questions.question: Three things a plant needs to grow are water, air and:
questions.explanation: Plants need water, air and sunlight to grow well.

questions.question: Which of these is the largest type of plant?
questions.explanation: Trees are the largest plants, with thick, hard trunks.

questions.question: Cotton, used to make our clothes, comes from a:
questions.explanation: Cotton comes from the cotton plant.

questions.question: A plant left without any water for many days will:
questions.explanation: Without water, a plant dries up and wilts.

questions.question: Which part of a plant later changes into a fruit?
questions.explanation: After blooming, a flower slowly changes into a fruit.

questions.question: A rose plant is best described as a:
questions.explanation: A rose plant is a shrub, bushy with hard stems near the ground.

questions.question: Sitting under a tree on a hot day feels cool because the tree gives:
questions.explanation: Trees give shade, which keeps us cool.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct order of plant growth?
questions.explanation: A seed grows into a seedling, and the seedling grows into a full plant.
